title: The Evidence Integration Seminar · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
You are a student at a seminar. Write a short paragraph (about 150 words) for your classmates explaining how you would combine two different types of evidence to understand a local problem, such as traffic or waste. Use at least one comparison and one example.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
